name: Return the Book
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.

Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  It is good to know he is free.

We must have him.  I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King.  After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
narrative.objectives: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.
narrative.offerRewardText:
My book?!? So you were the thief who stole it!

But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor? He is in Lordaeron?

If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
narrative.requestItemsText: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 8 to 12, 3,330 XP in all.

quests.name: Graverobbers
quests.objectiveText: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.

quests.name: The Prodigal Lich
quests.objectiveText: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Lich's Identity
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: Return the Book
quests.objectiveText: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.

quests.name: Proving Allegiance
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning. Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her. Return to Gunther on his island.

quests.name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
